description: Kubernetes security assessment playbook. Use when probing an API server, kubelet, etcd, dashboard, or ingress surface from outside or with limited credentials. Covers unauthenticated /version and /api probes, anonymous auth and system:anonymous bindings, the system:unauthenticated group, kubelet 10250/10255 exec and log endpoints, etcd exposure, dashboard and ingress misconfiguration, RBAC enumeration with kubectl auth can-i --list, service-account token hunting, secret decoding, admission-controller and PodSecurity bypass checks, and exposed-service triage.
